config.title: Fishing Assistant
config.option.auto_cast.description: Cast again when the assistant is ready and fishing can safely continue.
config.option.auto_hook.description: React when a fish bites without requiring manual input.
config.option.auto_minigame.description: Control the fishing bar while a normal minigame is active.
config.option.auto_close.description: Confirm the caught-fish popup when it is safe to continue.
config.option.auto_treasure.description: Collect items from the fishing treasure menu using the configured inventory policy.
config.option.auto_pause.description: Choose whether the assistant warns or pauses when the configured late-night time is reached.
config.option.pause_time.description: The in-game hour when late-night fishing warnings begin.
config.option.warning_count.description: The number of warnings allowed before automatic fishing pauses.
config.option.inventory_full_action.desc: Choose how automatic treasure collection responds when no inventory space remains.
config.option.auto_trash.description: Remove newly acquired items selected in the visual junk list.
config.option.junk_lists.description: Choose exactly which items are junk and which items must never be treated as junk.
config.option.trash_fish: Allow fish to be treated as junk
config.option.trash_fish.description: Allow fish selected in the junk list to be discarded automatically.
config.option.auto_eat.description: Select food from this player's inventory when energy reaches the configured threshold.
config.option.eat_energy.description: Automatically eat when this player's remaining energy reaches this percentage.
config.option.eat_fish.description: Permit automatic food selection to consume fish from this player's inventory.
config.option.attach_bait.description: Attach preferred bait from this player's inventory when the rod can use it.
config.option.spawn_bait: Spawn bait when none is available
config.option.spawn_bait.description: Create the preferred bait when automatic attachment cannot find any. This is a cheat option.
config.option.bait_amount.description: The stack size created when spawning bait is enabled and none is available.
config.option.preferred_bait.description: Choose a specific bait to attach, or Any to use the first compatible bait found.
config.option.attach_tackle.description: Attach preferred tackle from this player's inventory when the rod has an empty slot.
config.option.preferred_tackle.descripti: Choose a specific tackle for the first slot, or Any to use the first compatible tackle found.
config.option.second_tackle.description: Choose tackle for the Advanced Iridium Rod's second slot, or Any to use the first compatible tackle found.
config.option.spawn_tackle: Spawn tackle when none is available
config.option.spawn_tackle.description: Create preferred tackle when automatic attachment cannot find any. This is a cheat option.
config.option.infinite_bait.description: Prevent the assistant's fishing workflow from consuming equipped bait.
config.option.infinite_tackle.descriptio: Prevent the assistant's fishing workflow from consuming tackle durability.
config.option.instant_bite.description: Remove the normal wait before a fish bites after casting.
config.option.skip_minigame.description: Choose whether eligible fishing minigames are completed instantly.
config.option.fish_amount.description: The preferred number of fish produced for catches which support multiple fish.
config.option.fish_quality.description: Override caught fish quality when this assistance option is enabled.
config.option.always_perfect.description: Treat completed fishing minigames as perfect catches when supported.
config.option.max_fish_size.description: Use the maximum size roll for caught fish when supported.
config.option.difficulty_multiplier.desc: Multiply the current fish's difficulty before applying the additive adjustment.
config.option.difficulty_additive.descri: Add or subtract this amount after applying the difficulty multiplier.
config.option.instant_treasure: Collect treasure during the minigame instantly
config.option.instant_treasure.descripti: Complete treasure-bar progress immediately when a treasure target appears.
config.option.treasure_chance.descriptio: Keep the vanilla chance, always create treasure, or prevent normal fishing treasure.
config.option.golden_treasure_chance.des: Keep the vanilla chance, always create golden treasure, or prevent it.
config.option.cast_power.description: The casting power used when the assistant automatically casts the rod.
config.option.unlock_cast_time.descripti: How long the cast button must be held before manual casting can choose its own power.
config.option.starter_rod: Fishing rod when none is owned
config.option.starter_rod.description: Choose the fishing rod added when this local player loads a save without one.
config.option.hud_position.description: Choose which side of this player's viewport displays assistant status.
config.option.fish_preview.description: Show information about the current fishing target while the minigame is active.
config.option.fish_name.description: Include the current fish's name in the preview.
config.option.show_treasure.description: Include fishing treasure information in the preview.
config.option.uncaught_fish.description: Allow preview details for fish this player has never caught.
config.option.legendary_fish.description: Allow preview details when the current target is legendary.
config.option.enchant_auto_hook.descript: Temporarily add Auto-Hook to the equipped fishing rod when supported.
config.option.enchant_efficient.descript: Temporarily add Efficient to the equipped fishing rod when supported.
config.option.enchant_master.description: Temporarily add Master to the equipped fishing rod when supported.
config.option.enchant_preserving.descrip: Temporarily add Preserving to the equipped fishing rod when supported.
config.option.remove_enchantments.descri: Remove enchantments added by the assistant when the fishing rod is no longer equipped.
config.option.toggle_automation.descript: The keybind used to enable or disable fishing automation for this local player.
config.option.toggle_treasure.descriptio: The keybind used to switch treasure targeting during the fishing minigame.
config.option.open_config.description: The keybind used to open this custom configuration menu.
config.option.add_test_rod.description: Add an Advanced Iridium Rod when this local player has no fishing rod.
config.junk_picker.title: Junk list editor
config.status.defaults_loaded: Defaults loaded. Select Apply to save them.
config.status.save_failed: The configuration could not be saved. Check the SMAPI log.
hud.title: Fishing Assistant
debug.test_rod.already_owned: This player already has a fishing rod.
debug.test_rod.inventory_full: The inventory is full. Free a slot and try again.
debug.test_rod.failed: The test fishing rod could not be added. Check the SMAPI log.
